attempted_axis: The standing honesty control: draw three EQUIVALENT-tier functions at random and follow each end to end -- raw compiler output, the shipped rule, the postprocessed object, the linked image -- looking for a credit that is not backed by bytes.

Raw-vs-rule size mismatch: none (getSinCos 14 owed / 14 changed; vsprintf 22 owed / 30 changed, which is EXPECTED and not a discrepancy -- a permutation rewrites words that were already equal, so 'words changed' is an upper bound on, not a measure of, the residual, and a future audit must not treat the two numbers as comparable). Rule class not reaching the residual class: none -- vsprintf's 17 non-regfield words are matched by a composed rule that declares a permutation, and getSinCos's 14 regfield words by a bare recolor. Postprocessed object not matching: none, all three real 0. Image: doldiff exit 0. The one anomaly in the whole pass was the chained-replay artifact above, and it was in the audit method.

attributes.method_defect_found: THE AUDIT'S OWN FIRST PASS PRODUCED A FALSE REFUSAL, and the mechanism is worth more than the audit. `wr_try_rule.py game/world/btricol LineLineDist <entry>` returned `REFUSED (raw postprocess body): LineLineDist: input hash 49596e08342174450623a347ea14704af6233f5d39a6a210bd13599ec499498e != expected cb0b03c8b9fc6998...`, which reads exactly like a pin whose body has drifted. It had not. LineLineDist carries TWO entries in game/world/btricol and msgDraw carries two in game/ui/message -- they are not duplicates, they are CHAINED STAGES: stage 0 is `instruction_permutation` alone (SCHEDULE_CANDIDATE, 2 permuted instructions) and stage 1 is `copy_register_fields + instruction_permutation` (REGISTER_ONLY, 5 permuted), and `entry0.after_sha256 == entry1.before_sha256` is True for both functions. Replaying stage 1 alone against the RAW body compares the raw hash to the INTERMEDIATE hash and must refuse. Replaying stage 0 alone returns `APPLIED-NOT-EQUAL ... 2 word(s) changed` (msgDraw: 4), which is also correct and also not a verdict on the pin. CONSEQUENCES: (a) 154 entries over 152 functions is fully reconciled -- the two extras are second stages, and progress's `EQUIVALENT 11.25% (152 fns)` counts functions, so the tier size is right; (b) `wr_try_rule.py` replays ONE fragment and there is no single call that replays a function's whole chain, so any per-pin audit tool must group entries by (unit, function) and fold them in file order before comparing hashes; (c) the refusal text is the exact shape AGENTS.md warns about beside `t16_rederive_body.py` -- 'NEVER paste the hash out of webfrank's abort message' -- and a lane auditing a chained pin meets that message while nothing is wrong, so the hazard is not only 'do not re-bless', it is 'this message has a benign cause that no tool names'.

(1) game/mb/mb_particle::getSinCos -- RAW `27 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 14, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 0, PINNED = YES`, DECODE REGFIELD-ONLY 14 / IMMEDIATE 0 / BRANCH 0 / OPCODE 0 / RELOCATED 0. RULE `copy_register_fields: true`, audit REGISTER_ONLY/27, mechanism 0 chars (it is one of the 41). REPLAY through the real apply_patch: `[datum screen at FULL strength: L3 reads orig/GUNE5D/sys/main.dol]` then `BYTE-EQUAL (raw postprocess body); 14 word(s) changed` -- the rule closes exactly the 14 words the raw read owes, no more. POSTPROCESSED `== getSinCos: MATCH (pool-name noise only), 0 real diff lines`. LINK: Object(NonMatching), so our object is NOT linked and the DOL gate says nothing about it -- the credit rests wholly on the object comparison, which is exactly what the EQUIVALENT tier claims and no more. (2) game/crt/vsprintf::vsprintf -- RAW `665 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 22, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 14`, DECODE REGFIELD-ONLY 5 / IMMEDIATE 3 / OPCODE 14, i.e. 17 of 22 words outside every register-field class, which is why the rule is COMPOSED: copy_register_fields + equivalent_copy_form + instruction_permutation, audit SCHEDULE/665 with permuted_instructions 18 and register_field_instructions 12, mechanism 2,086 chars. REPLAY `BYTE-EQUAL (raw postprocess body); 30 word(s) changed`. POSTPROCESSED `== vsprintf: MATCH-MODULO-RELOC-NAMING, 4 real diff lines [artifact-filtered; raw rows 16, of which 0 non-reloc]`, `--count` real 0. LINK: Object(Matching), so this one IS linked and `tools/gdl/doldiff.py` exits 0 with `DOL matches (1 expected clean_extab diff suppressed)` -- end to end, source to image. (3) game/world/btricol::LineLineDist -- RAW `464 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 136, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 0`, DECODE REGFIELD-ONLY 132 / IMMEDIATE 4. TWO chained entries (see below). POSTPROCESSED `== LineLineDist: MATCH (pool-name noise only), 0 real diff lines`, `--count` real 0. LINK: Object(Matching), covered by the same doldiff pass. NO OVERSTATED CREDIT FOUND: in all three the raw body genuinely differs, the rule genuinely closes it, the postprocessed object genuinely matches the dtk-split target, and the two linked ones are genuinely in a matching image.
